decision.note: Feature development can pause; resume for real bugs, factual/data corrections, or compatibility breakage.

strengths: End-to-end digital-humanities product with coherent people/place/event/relationship/map/timeline/emperor/chronology/insight exploration.
Distinctive and coherent paper/ink/cinnabar/gold UI; no redesign is justified by current evidence.
Mature engineering surface with sharded data, lazy loading, offline behavior, payload budgets, build checks and browser-oriented validation.
Historical uncertainty is preserved instead of being replaced with false precision.

findings.title: Community and release surface is lighter than the core product
evidence: Formal community/release surfaces are less developed than the already-complete product.
findings.recommendation: Do not reopen active development solely for repository ceremony; add it when external contribution or formal release needs become real.

findings.title: Tracked standalone artifact is large
evidence: standalone.html is approximately 5.5 MB and tracked at repository root.
findings.recommendation: Leave the working boundary unchanged unless repository size becomes a practical problem.

findings.title: Top-level navigation is dense but not currently broken
evidence: Twelve major views create density, but conceptual grouping exists and the UI remains coherent.
findings.recommendation: Revisit only after concrete usability evidence.

limitations: Exact audited-HEAD green CI status was not independently observed.
This review is not copyright or legal clearance.
Historical factual accuracy was not exhaustively verified entity by entity.
recheck_triggers: A real user-facing bug is reported.
A historical fact/date/place/relationship is shown incorrect.
Browser, dependency, Pages or service-worker changes break behavior.
Concrete usability evidence shows navigation failure.
The project begins accepting external contributions or formal releases.

reasons: No new publication blocker was identified.
Continue avoiding committed source-book full text and preserve structured/derived-data boundaries.

evidence: Purpose, data scope and exploration model are clearly defined and implemented.
CI defines syntax, tests, build, data invariants, payload and browser checks; exact HEAD green status was not observed.
Static delivery has a small attack surface and constrained workflow permissions; formal security/community surface is not a blocker.
Dependency/workflow surface is comparatively small and controlled.
Unified build/check path, tests and data architecture are documented.
Online and standalone outputs plus automated validation are mature; formal tagged release/versioning is lighter.
README provides extensive product, architecture, build and navigation documentation.
Data, generators, templates, static delivery and tests are separated and guarded by checks.
Public product is well documented while formal contribution/security/release surfaces are comparatively sparse.
